item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President identifies his completion of a statutory decision process but does not specify or itself impose the legal outcome in this segment.","evidence":"I have determined the action I will take with respect to the report of the United States International Trade Commission"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory national-economic-interest determination that denies the requested copper import relief; any later administrative steps are merely consequential.","evidence":"I have determined that granting import relief is not consistent with our national economic interest."},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The segment directs executive officials to develop an assistance plan and monitor industry conditions, without prescribing a later binding legal consequence.","evidence":"I have directed the Secretary of Labor to work with State and local officials to develop a plan of job retraining and relocation assistance"}]}
